dialogues.speaker: "Game Master"
dialogues.text: "Though the Marechaussee Hunters had much they wished to share with one another, at this moment, the joy of reunion must yield to the crisis at hand."

dialogues.speaker: "Game Master"
dialogues.text: Now then, the combat round continues. You have the first turn.

dialogues.speaker: "Game Master"
dialogues.text: Also, since we have a new member joining us, I'll be adding some "Dark Cards" to boost the enemies' various abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} isn't a sudden addition, {M#he's}{F#she's} been traveling with us all along.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: We've just, uh... parted for a short while, that's all! Totally normal!

dialogues.speaker: "Game Master"
dialogues.text: Ah, I've already counted the "Dark Cards." You should start discussing your tactics.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: #Anyway, let's stick to the original strategy. Now that we have {NICKNAME} with us, we have enough people.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Illuga and I will hold the line out front against the monsters' assault.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: #Jahoda, {NICKNAME}, you circle around to the back and take 'em all down in one swoop.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Alright, leave it to me! Hehe, we "Masters of Qi" get huge damage boosts when attacking from behind.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Uh, but, hehe... Why are you a Chef? How's a Chef... gonna perform a sneak attack?

choices.text: I can use my frying pan for a Charged Attack.

response.speaker: "Game Master"
response.text: Correct. Your frying pan is a blunt weapon that, given the right card draw, can inflict prolonged stun effects on enemies.

choices.text: I can persuade opponents to surrender with food.

response.speaker: "Game Master"
response.text: Yes. If you can actually draw good cards.
